notes.text: Modular Avatar and VRCFury both run as non-destructive build plugins. They can coexist, but if both drive the same toggle/menu the merge order matters - prefer one system per feature to avoid duplicate menu controls.
Lock Poiyomi materials BEFORE uploading (unlocked shaders fail VRChat's shader keyword limits and bloat the avatar). Unlock to edit, re-lock to ship.

Install the avatar base prefab first, then drag accessory/clothing prefabs UNDER the avatar so Modular Avatar's Bone Proxy / Merge Armature can find the target armature. Accessories placed at scene root won't merge.

Quest/Android: VRChat enforces material/poly/texture limits and only Quest-compatible shaders (no Poiyomi). Keep a separate Quest material set + fallback. Use the PC<->Quest twin (e.g. LEAF / LEAF QUEST) so you ship both.
Use PhysBones (VRChat SDK3), not legacy DynamicBones, for hair/clothing jiggle. PhysBones count against the avatar's performance rank.
